input.summary: Express the Deliverable conformance period numerically, extend it to 12 months for software Deliverables, and untie the warranty refund from the narrowly defined "Fees" (Implementation Fee only).
input.comment: [Playbook] We have expressed the conformance period in numerals and set it at twelve (12) months for software Deliverables (ninety (90) days for all other Deliverables), consistent with our standard 12-month software / 90-day services warranty. We have also clarified that the warranty refund covers all amounts paid for the non-conforming item, because "Fees" is defined in Section 1.5 as the Implementation Fee only, which would leave subscription and service charges unrefundable; if you prefer, we can instead broaden the Section 1.5 definition.

ops.oldText: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria.
ops.newText: For twelve (12) months after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, in the case of software Deliverables, and for ninety (90) days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, in the case of all other Deliverables, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria.

ops.oldText: receive a refund of Fees paid for it
ops.newText: receive a refund of all amounts paid for it (and not only the Implementation Fee)
